gate_rules: No build without validated buyer pain and first MVP slice.
No product can advance to build_ready if basic foundational data, enums, rules or workflows are missing.
No marketplace or seller OS build without category tree, data model, workflow rules, location logic, listing status rules and pricing logic.
No full marketplace build before one-seller prototype works.
No sell without offer, CFO margin check and delivery scope.
No deploy without QA, health check and rollback note.
No maintenance promise without support boundary and price.
No stage may advance on documents alone when a demo proof can be created.
No public financial guidance product without legal/compliance review and risk wording guardrails.
